literal: Among excellent gains, an equal thing to that is not, with anyone, the absence of envy if obtained.
translation: If one can achieve the absence of envy towards anyone, there is no equal to that among excellent gains.
modern: யாரிடத்திலும் பொறாமை இல்லாத தன்மையை ஒருவர் பெற்றால், அவர் அடையும் சிறந்த பேறுகளில் அதற்கு இணையானது வேறு எதுவும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme value of a mind free from envy. The phrase 'அழுக்காற்றின் அன்மை' means the complete absence of envy towards anyone ('யார் மாட்டும்'). The poet declares that if a person can attain this state, there is no other excellent gain ('விழுப்பேறு') that can equal it. Because envy destroys one's own peace and character, being entirely free from it is presented as the highest possible achievement.
